loops.minute_1: Manual clicking accumulates first cookies; player purchases Cursor (first automation building). Feedback loop: number increases, next purchase unlocks.
loops.minute_10: Exponential scaling via Cursor+Grandma synergies. Golden Cookies (random events worth x7 CPS) reward attention. Early minigame unlocks. Passive income becomes visible.
loops.hour_5: ~10+ factories active. Grandmapocalypse event system introduces risk/reward mechanics. Sugar Lumps (24-hour cooldown resource) unlock building levels and minigames. Garden minigame introduces genetics.
loops.endgame: Ascension cycles (voluntary reset for permanent Heavenly Chip bonuses). Frenzy+Click Frenzy+Building Bonus combo chains (expert play). 637 achievements = infinite collection. Pantheon customization (late prestige system).

objectives.player_goal: Infinite accumulation + achievement collection (637 total) + optimize combo chains + discover hidden mechanics

games.retention_answer: Exponential progression creates eternal sense of power. Sugar Lumps (24h cycle) + 637 achievements provide daily check-ins and infinite long-term goals. Golden Cookies reward frequent returning. Seasonal events (Christmas, Halloween) create calendar-based reasons to play. Wrinkler/Grandmapocalypse narrative provides discovery-based engagement. Prestige resets offer satisfying 'restart with advantage' cycles every ~10-20 hours.

loops.minute_1: Direct clicking defeats monsters, earning gold. Purchase first hero (Treebeast) = automation begins. Feedback: monster health decreases, gold increases, hero levels up.
loops.minute_10: Multiple heroes synergize. Early upgrades increase damage. First ascension (reset for permanent Hero Souls) teaches the prestige cycle. Strategy emerges: which hero to prioritize for cost/benefit.
loops.hour_5: Zones 200-2000 progression. Ancient farming (permanent bonuses across runs). Gild management (concentrate multipliers on primary hero). Ascension loops: farm → reach wall → ascend → spend souls → farm again.
loops.endgame: Zone 10,000+. Transcension timing (mega-reset for Ancient Souls, cross-transcension prestige). Outsider upgrades (meta-bonuses). Optimization becomes mathematical: when to ascend, which Outsider to upgrade, sequence of builds.

objectives.player_goal: Reach maximum zone; optimize ascension timing; collect Ancients; transcend for long-term prestige

games.retention_answer: Prestige/ascension cycle creates satisfying 'mini-victory' every session (farm → hit wall → reset with +10% bonus). Long-term progression visible across runs (Hero Soul growth, zone progression 1→200→2000→10000+). Idle mechanic enables casual play without active attention. Each Ancients purchase (+1% per level) provides incremental sense of progress. Transcension (mega-reset) creates secondary long-term loop. Mathematical optimization appeals to theorycrafting players.

loops.minute_1: Kittens assign to jobs (Worker). Catnip resource production begins. First buildings (Hut, Farm) unlocked via purchases. Feedback: catnip number increases; new buildings/job assignments appear.
loops.minute_10: First technologies unlock (Agriculture). Seasons introduce variable production (spring/summer=+yield; winter=-70% yield risk). Resource diversification (wood, ore added). Assignation strategy emerges: balance worker vs job roles.
loops.hour_5: Deep tech tree (50+ technologies). Multiple resources and cross-resource crafting (wood+ore→metal). Management complexity rises. Winter survival risk: harsh weather can starve village if overexpanded. Strategic building = survival challenge.
loops.endgame: Space buildings, space techs, exotic matter loops. Timeloop mechanic (rogue-like reset for prestige bonuses). Narrative progression: civilization leaves planet. Late-game focused on optimization and exploring prestige resets.

objectives.victory_condition: Reach space age (major long-term milestone); maintain non-zero kitten population across winter
objectives.defeat_condition: Catnip reaches zero; kitten population dies (game can end if overexpanded before harsh winter)
objectives.player_goal: Progress tech tree; survive seasonal cycles; expand village; eventually colonize space

games.retention_answer: Survivability (threat of starvation) creates tension absent in pure idle games, requiring active seasonal management. Winter cycles force periodic check-ins (player must prepare 3-4 seasons in advance). 50+ resource web rewards discovery and mastery. Tech tree provides structured long-term progression goals. Prestige resets (timeloop) offer replay value and 'new start with advantage' cycles. Narrative arc (leaving planet) provides thematic long-term engagement. Village management depth appeals to strategy players.
